caption:
Stop sending cold emails that open with "Dear First Name." It's getting you deleted instantly.

Here's the boring automation I run instead.

It spotted an agency site where a sticky cookie banner sat right on top of their valuation form's submit button.

My cold email was three sentences: "Your cookie banner is blocking your valuation button on mobile. Here's the screenshot." No corporate pitch.

Send us your site and we will name the one thing to fix: thecopygrind3r.pages.dev
